en: Illustrated card showing a romanticized historical rider with a feathered hat, pink cloak, and purple garment standing beside his saddled horse on a riverbank. He looks across the water toward a small town with church spires and steep‑roofed houses. Trees frame the scene in the foreground. At the bottom there is handwritten cursive text and the printed illustrator's name "Schöbel."
